_readme: Ratchet for scripts/visual/{matrix,interactions}.mjs. A finding not listed here fails npm run test:visual; so does an entry that no longer reproduces on a full run (remove it in the PR that fixes it). Add an entry only with a reason and an "issue": an ISSUES id, or "untriaged" with a reason that says what to check. "volatile": true marks a finding that depends on content order (which posts sit on /blog/ page 1), not CSS: it is allowlisted but never reported stale.
